description: This Java source file defines the 'ShortcutPublisher' Activity for an Android app that manages app shortcuts, including creating, updating, deleting, and pinning shortcuts. It includes methods for handling shortcut dynamic and pinned states, interacting with the ShortcutManager API, and UI event handlers for user actions.

classes.name: ShortcutPublisher
classes.description: Main activity class that manages app shortcuts, handles UI interactions for creating, updating, deleting, and pinning shortcuts, and demonstrates use of ShortcutManager API.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, sets content view, obtains ShortcutManager service, and sets up UI list.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Refreshes the shortcuts list when activity resumes.

methods.name: getAllShortcuts
methods.description: Retrieves all shortcuts associated with this activity from manifest, dynamic, and pinned shortcuts.

methods.name: refreshList
methods.description: Sorts and updates shortcut list displayed in the UI.

methods.name: dumpCurrentShortcuts
methods.description: Logs current dynamic and pinned shortcuts for debugging.

methods.name: showToast
methods.description: Displays a toast message to the user.

methods.name: showThrottledToast
methods.description: Shows a message when shortcut API requests are throttled.

methods.name: callApi
methods.description: Wraps calls to ShortcutManager API with error handling and throttling notification.

methods.name: addRandomIntents
methods.description: Adds random intent data and icons to ShortcutInfo.Builder.

methods.name: addRandomIntents
methods.description: Adds random intent data and icons to ShortcutInfoCompat.Builder.

methods.name: onPublishPressed
methods.description: Creates sample shortcuts and sets them as dynamic shortcuts.

methods.name: onDeleteAllPressed
methods.description: Removes all dynamic shortcuts.

methods.name: formatTime
methods.description: Formats a timestamp into a human-readable string.

methods.name: onAddPressed
methods.description: Adds a new dynamic shortcut with current timestamp and sequence number.

methods.name: onUpdatePressed
methods.description: Updates existing shortcuts' intents with new random data.

methods.name: launch
methods.description: Starts the activity linked to the shortcut.

methods.name: deleteDynamic
methods.description: Removes a specified dynamic shortcut.

methods.name: onShowNotificationPressed
methods.description: Displays a notification with remote input action.

methods.name: onRequestPinPressed
methods.description: Requests the system to pin a shortcut.

methods.name: requestPinShortcut
methods.description: Handles pinning a shortcut via ShortcutManagerCompat.
